description: Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM. TL;DR Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature. Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself. The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder. GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter. What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off. You are technical enough to argue with engineers. AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better. You can write. A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second. You write specs worth acting on. The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter. You know what looks good. You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually. You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec. You want to be coached hard. Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast. You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. We want to see the workflow, not hear it described. You want the scope to grow. The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available. What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients What you'll be scoping over your first year: Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on. Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us. AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in. Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself. You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room. This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor. Requirements / Nice to have 3+ years as a PM, TPM or delivery lead in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows Notion fluency Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on. How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps. Intro call : a quick chat to see if there's a match Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed Interview Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around About us GlassDollar brings startups and corporations together to accelerate innovation. We create connections that enable startups to grow and corporations to evolve successfully through forward-thinking solutions. With data, software, and a clear mission, we make collaboration easy and effective. Our success? That's down to the people who make up GlassDollar. We are more than a team. We are a community that strengthens and inspires each other and shows what is possible every single day. Here, you can not only be yourself, but also put your ideas into practice. Openness, trust, and genuine cooperation are not just buzzwords for us, but the heart of our culture. Our values shape our everyday lives: Self-awareness : We know our strengths, weaknesses, and sources of energy, and we use them purposefully to achieve great things. Entrepreneurship: We create real added value, efficiently, passionately, and with the courage to go the extra mile. Purposeful Impact: Everything we do has a clear focus and makes a positive difference. Inclusion: Diversity is our strength. We bring our authentic selves to work and promote open, appreciative collaboration.
title: Associate Product Owner (m/f/d)

description: Company Mission Payhawk is a leading global spend management solution for scaling businesses. Headquartered in London and combining company cards, reimbursable expenses and accounts payable into a single product; its future-facing technology enables finance teams to control and automate company spending at scale. The Payhawk customer base includes fast-growing and mature multinational companies in 32 countries including LuxAir and Wagestream. With offices in New York, London, Berlin, Munich , Barcelona, Paris, Amsterdam, Vilnius and Sofia; Payhawk is backed by renowned investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Greenoaks, QED Investors, Bek Ventures and Eleven Ventures. Our values include supporting flat hierarchies, taking ownership and responsibility, seeking and providing feedback, managing constructive critique, and speaking our minds. We understand that the best ideas don’t all come from the same place, so we encourage diversity and inclusion in all areas of our work. The future of fintech is about more than money, it is about continual learning and empowered teams. We’re also on a journey to measure and improve our environmental and social impact . From virtual cards to digital subscriptions, our software and automation help take paper out of the equation for our customers, too. We’re changing the world of payments, and we’re looking for an exceptional team to help us. About The Role We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to lead the creation and optimisation of one of our global cross-functional GTM Pods strategy— small, agile squads focused on growing a specific product area. Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you will be key to accelerating our commercial growth and building our product-lead brand. You will work closely with product leadership and strategically lead a team of marketing experts. To excel in this role you need to be data-driven, a great collaborator, have a high attention to detail, and a passion for both the commercial and technical sides of a SaaS business. You need to be able to collect and synthesize information to create compelling go-to-market strategies. Key Responsibilities Become an expert and centralize understanding of our buying audience (customers & personas) Become a market expert for our product, e.g. competitor strengths/weaknesses, target audience pain points, tech ecosystem Provide clarity to Sales and Marketing teams on why Payhawk is valuable to our buying audience Oversee the process for creating impactful product positioning, value propositions and messaging. Ensuring this is rolled out consistently and iterated on Collaborate with Marketing and Sales Enablement to produce impactful campaigns and content for the entire customer lifecycle Partner with Product to define the product strategy and roadmap based on market and sales insights Partner with Product on product Design Sprints to research and plan the go-to-market proposition of new features Lead the creation and maintenance of competitive enablement for Sales and Product teams Oversee goals, strategy and execution for new product and feature launches Become a conduit between the Product and Commercial teams to ensure shared understanding and strategic alignment Track, measure, and continuously iterate across win rate, deal velocity, pipeline, adoption, and expansion Qualifications 2+ years B2B product marketing or equivalent experience. Ideally, this includes experience in B2B SaaS and/or a high-growth startup environment A highly skilled communicator with deep expertise in writing, storytelling, and live enablement. You possess a strong track record of transforming complicated concepts into easily digestible and engaging content, including white papers, web pages, videos, ROI calculators, and presentations Proven ability to leverage advanced AI tools to accelerate marketing results, specifically across content generation, rapid messaging optimization, and market intelligence analysis You are an analytical, data-driven and customer-obsessed decision-maker You are humble but ambitious and eager to make an impact Company Benefits Flexible working hours 30 days holiday paid leave Payhawk company card Monthly travel allowance Health insurance Fitness membership Competitive compensation package Regular team-wide events Exchange program to another one of our offices (London, Paris, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Munich, Sofia). Please note that unfortunately we cannot provide visa sponsorship, and to be considered for this role, candidates must be able to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country they apply for. Payhawk is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
title: Product Marketing Manager

description: Die meisten Product-Rollen auf deinem Level geben dir ein Backlog und einen Sprint. Diese gibt dir eine Frage: Warum springt ein Händler zwischen Gebot und Kauf ab? Du gehst in die Daten, sprichst mit Kunden, baust die Lösung mit Engineering und misst, ob es gewirkt hat. Standort: Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice. Über uns CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche. One Platform. One Profit Engine. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Features und Verbesserungen in deinem Produktbereich – von der Anforderung über die Umsetzung mit Engineering bis zum Launch. Du analysierst, wo Händler im Kaufprozess abspringen, und entwickelst Maßnahmen, die die Conversion messbar erhöhen. Du arbeitest an der technischen Anbindung von Partnern und begleitest API-Integrationen gemeinsam mit Engineering. Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Händlern, sammelst Feedback strukturiert ein und übersetzt es in konkrete Anforderungen. Du pflegst und priorisierst dein Backlog eigenständig und begründest deine Priorisierung mit Daten. Du verfolgst die KPIs deiner Features nach dem Launch und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab. Was du mitbringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder als Product Owner, idealerweise in einem digitalen B2B-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld Erste Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung – du hast schon Funnel analysiert und Verbesserungen umgesetzt Technisches Verständnis für API-Integrationen: Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, aber verstehen, worüber Engineering spricht Ausgeprägte analytische Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbst mit Daten und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab Starke Problemlösungskompetenz und Eigeninitiative: Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern erkennst selbst, wo es hakt Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich und arbeitest gern direkt mit Kunden Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch verhandlungssicher Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden (Scrum/Kanban) und Tools wie Jira und Confluence KI-affine Arbeitsweise – du nutzt Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Copilot aktiv im Arbeitsalltag Von Vorteil Erfahrung mit Checkout-, Payment- oder Finanzierungsprozessen (z. B. BNPL) Erste Berührungspunkte mit Partnerschaften oder dem Automotive-Umfeld Was dich bei uns erwartet Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Homeoffice – plus 10 Tage „Work from Anywhere" pro Jahr 28 Tage Urlaub 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss Bezahltes Deutschlandticket FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg Moderne IT-Ausstattung für dein tägliches Arbeiten Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk, Meditations- & Gebetsraum Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.
title: Product Manager (m/w/d)

description: We are looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager (with previous hands-on development experience) to take our developer-facing products to market. You will own positioning, messaging and go-to-market for these products, and orchestrate programs, motions, and campaigns across multiple channels to drive meaningful growth. Your work will directly influence revenue KPIs as well as product roadmap and priorities. This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable reading documentation, running an API call, and testing the products you market from the user’s perspective. Responsibilities: Positioning & Messaging: Own the strategic positioning and messaging for your products. Keep it differentiated and technically accurate, and ensure consistency across all channels to improve conversion and pipeline quality. Go-to-Market Leadership: Own go-to-market and launch strategy, planning, and execution - including commercial decisions on pricing, packaging, and promotions - aligning teams across the company to drive pipeline and revenue. Market Intelligence: Own the market, customer, and competitive intelligence for your domain - continuously gather and synthesize insights to guide GTM strategy and inform roadmap, pricing, and positioning decisions. Agentic Growth: Contribute to our strategy and execution for discoverability and selection by AI agents - documentation, content, and integrations that make our products the default choice for agents and the developers who use them. Sales Enablement: Own sales enablement for your products - arm customer-facing teams with the tools, content, and knowledge needed to confidently and effectively sell and support them. Copywriting: Write and own the copy for all related marketing and GTM initiatives - product pages, launch content, technical comparisons, and enablement materials. Cross-Functional Contribution: Contribute to channel and campaign strategy, brand narrative and thought-leadership themes, and partner and ecosystem programs. Requirements: 3+ years in product marketing or technical marketing, ideally for API-first, data, infrastructure, or developer tools products. Proven experience taking technical products to market and running cross-functional programs involving Product, Sales, Growth, and DevRel teams. Technical fluency: you understand how software gets built - the development lifecycle, how developers evaluate and adopt tools, AI ecosystem and the role of coding agents and modern coding environments in day-to-day development work. Strong writing skills in English - clear, concise, and precise, for both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset: comfortable with funnel metrics, adoption data, and win/loss analysis Big plus Hands-on development experience - a current or former developer is a strong advantage Background in AI/ML data ecosystems (training data, RAG, agents, MCP) Experience with both self-serve (PLG) and enterprise sales motions
title: Technical Product Marketing Manager (previous developer) - EMEA

description: We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own how the product reaches the market. You sit between product and customer. You'll know what's being built well enough to explain it clearly, and know the users well enough to know which parts they actually care about. Every meaningful release gets a plan from you: who needs to hear about it, what they need to hear, and how it reaches them. Mission Our client is building one of the most advanced AI meeting assistants on the market. They ship fast, new features, new integrations, new capabilities constantly. Most of it doesn't get the attention it deserves, not because it isn't good, but because turning what shipped into why it matters is real work. That's what this role is for. Responsibilities Drive go-to-market for every launch, from written and video content to website, in-product, email, social, and press. Shape positioning and messaging, define our edge against competitors and keep the story consistent everywhere customers meet us. Craft the copy that converts, landing pages, comparisons, feature announcements, changelogs. Clear on technical topics, and quick to swap a paragraph for a screenshot when it lands better. Live close to the customer, join sales calls, dig through support tickets, run interviews. Great product marketing comes from listening, not workshops. Sales and support, give the frontline the framing, materials, and answers they need for the tough questions. Track what actually works, measure launches, spot what converts, cut what doesn't, double down on what does. Qualifications 3–6 years in product marketing, ideally at a fast-shipping B2B SaaS company. Extra points if you've built the function from the ground up. Excellent writing, full stop, send us a piece you're proud of. Sharp product instinct, grasp technical products fast and explain them to a total newcomer. An AI builder, not just a user, daily tools, automated workflows, a sharp eye for what's real versus demoware. Ops-minded and data-driven, juggle the moving parts of a launch, chase things to completion, and check your own numbers after. Fluent English; German a plus. We value drive, curiosity, and fast learning. Ready to help shape this company's story? Let's talk.
title: Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d)

description: Brief Info About Vinted Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. Information About The Position As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making. Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues. In this position, you’ll Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions. Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count. About You Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact Familiarity with SQL and Python Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences Fluent in English, both written and spoken Work perks The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme 30 days of paid annual leave Newest MacBook models Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture Lunch benefit per your workday Frequent team-building events A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted Access to a discounted gym membership plan Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution Supplemental Private Health Insurance Life and Disability insurance A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport A dog-friendly office Working at Vinted Workation policy Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time. Individual learning budget Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development. Hybrid work Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person. Equal opportunity We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match! The annual gross salary range for this position is: €69.600—€100.100 EUR
title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence

description: Über diesen Job Wie finden Kunden schnell das passende Umzugsunternehmen? Wie können wir diesen Prozess mit KI vereinfachen? Und wie können wir mit Marketing noch mehr Kunden gewinnen? Als Junior Digital Product Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest Du genau an diesen Fragen. Du konzipierst digitale Customer Journeys und bringst Deine Ideen in enger Abstimmung mit den Entwicklern ins Produkt ein. Du übernimmst Ownership für Deine Features , von der ersten Idee über Figma Screens und das technische Konzept bis zum Release. Du analysierst, wie Kunden unser Produkt tatsächlich nutzen, testest neue Ansätze und hinterfragst das bestehende Produkt grundlegend. GenAI ist dabei für Dich kein Buzzword. Du identifizierst sinnvolle Use Cases, probierst neue Möglichkeiten aus und baust daraus Features, die unseren Kunden einen echten Mehrwert bieten. Klingt spannend? Dann komm als Junior Digital Product Manager (m/w/d) zur CHECK24 Vergleichsportal Profis GmbH in Berlin und bring mit uns das digitale Erlebnis unserer Kunden auf das nächste Level. Was Du mitbringst Produkt- und Kundenfokus: Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, was ein digitales Produkt einfach und intuitiv macht, und ein Auge für modernes Design Analytisches und strukturiertes Denken: Du nutzt Daten und Kundenverhalten, um Probleme zu verstehen und daraus pragmatische Lösungen zu entwickeln Hands-on-Mentalität: Du hast Lust, neue Features im MVP-Stil zu konzipieren, zu testen und schnell ins Produkt zu bringen Technisches Interesse: Du arbeitest Dich schnell in technische Zusammenhänge ein und hast Lust, die Möglichkeiten von GenAI und LLMs für das Produkt zu nutzen Eigeninitiative und Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Themen und kommst schnell vom Denken ins Machen Einen sehr guten Studienabschluss, idealerweise mit wirtschaftlicher oder technischer Ausrichtung Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen Du entwickelst Features mit echtem Impact: Du konzipierst intuitive Customer Journeys und hilfst unseren Kunden, schnell und einfach den passenden Profi zu finden Du übernimmst Ownership: Von der ersten Idee über Figma Screens und das technische Konzept bis zum Release treibst Du Deine Features selbstständig voran Du verstehst unsere Kunden: Du analysierst das Kundenverhalten, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus Features mit echtem Impact Du machst AI zum Produkt: Du identifizierst relevante GenAI- und LLM-Use-Cases, testest neue Ansätze und verwandelst sie in konkrete Produktlösungen Du schaust über den Tellerrand: Du beobachtest Trends und Wettbewerber und nutzt die Erkenntnisse, um unser Produkt kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln Was wir Dir bieten Bei uns bekommst Du keine Rolle, in der Du erst nur hauptsächlich zuschaust. Von Anfang an arbeitest Du an echten Produkten, mit echten Daten und an Entscheidungen, die direkten Einfluss auf unser Geschäft haben. Dabei bekommst Du früh Verantwortung, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Freiheit, Deine Themen selbst voranzutreiben. Scale-up meets Start-up-Spirit Wir arbeiten dynamisch, auf Augenhöhe und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen – gute Ideen sollen nicht auf den nächsten Jour fixe warten. Du bekommst Raum für Eigeninitiative: Bring Deine Ideen ein, probiere Neues aus und übernimm Ownership für Themen mit echtem Impact. Wachse mit uns Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus: Wir bieten schnelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, Trainings und ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Bei uns lernst Du die unterschiedlichen Facetten digitaler Produktentwicklung kennen und kannst schnell Verantwortung für eigene Themen übernehmen. Lebe den CHECKito Spirit Wir verbringen auch abseits der Arbeit gerne Zeit zusammen – ob beim Kickern, After-Work oder bei regelmäßigen Firmen- und Teamevents. Für den Energieschub zwischendurch gibt es Obst, Gemüse, Müsli und Snacks sowie dreimal pro Woche kostenlose CHECKito Lunches. Profitiere Von Weiteren Benefits Für Deinen Weg zu unserem Büro am Spittelmarkt in Berlin-Mitte übernehmen wir Dein Deutschlandticket. Zusätzlich bieten wir attraktive Benefits wie unser bezuschusstes Bike-Leasing-Programm. Als Ausgleich zum Arbeitsalltag erwarten Dich kostenlose interne Sportkurse wie Yoga und CrossFit sowie bezuschusste externe Sportangebote, unter anderem über EGYM Wellpass.

description: Summary As a member of our Product Marketing group, you’ll represent the customer throughout a product’s journey from concept through development and launch. You’ll develop and apply insights to help infuse innovative features into our product-development process. Together with our team, you’ll work to craft groundbreaking ideas into tangible products that excite the world. At Apple, we combine product management/development and product marketing responsibilities into a single, cross functional Product Management role that collaborates with design, engineering, finance, legal, marketing communications, public relations, market research, sales and support for maximum impact across the organization. Description The Product Marketing Manager, Mac & iPad will own and drive the product centric marketing strategy for their respective product lines of business. A critical function of this role is to be the spokesperson for their products in market. The Product Marketing Manager in Germany is part of a team of product experts who champion products within their respective markets and seek innovative ways to keep our products at the heart of the customer conversation. You will play a critical role in driving Apple iPad and Mac adoption, go-to-market success, and alignment across functional partners. You will be responsible to deliver successful product launches, sustain momentum, effectively position our products and drive business growth. As the Geo expert for Germany, you will leverage your product and market insights to capture local requirements and communicate them to Worldwide Product Marketing and other stakeholders to inform their decisions. To be successful, you should demonstrate a strong passion for Apple products, a proven experience in marketing innovative technologies, and the analytical skills to distill business and customer insights into actionable recommendations. Responsibilities Articulate the product opportunity in market and provide product insight and leadership from introduction through end-of-life to both the Marketing and Sales organisations Execute product launches with excellence every time Contribute to the annual Marketing plan, outlining opportunity and actions that lead growth and category leadership Be the liaison between market and worldwide for all local business needs and feature requirements. Influence the product feature roadmap, making clear recommendations that improve customer experience Become a visible and vocal member of the Product Marketing team Be the guardian of product messaging & positioning across every customer touch point, advancing the cause of excellence Possess expert knowledge of competitive and 3rd party products and strategies. Make pricing and forecasting recommendations to management and cross-functional teams Build a sphere of influence across multiple internal functions / divisions Minimum Qualifications Experience in product marketing, product management, or related roles in Germany Familiarity across Apple hardware, software, and services, ideally with an interest or experience in the PC industry or consumer electronics Technical fluency with the ability to translate complex technical features into clear, relevant consumer benefits Excellent presentation skills, written and spoken, in both English and German. Ability to craft compelling product stories Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data and market insights to guide actions and recommendations Flexibility to travel (up to 25% of the time) Preferred Qualifications Curiosity, a passion for excellence, the ability to ask the right questions, and a resilient, problem-solving mindset. Flexible and willing to learn Experience working collaboratively with international teams in a multi-national company A resilient problem solver who gets things done, works effectively under pressure, flexible and willing to learn, confident but without ego Have deep project management skills, a teammate with strong influencing and collaboration skills and cross-functional leadership abilities MS/MA/MBA degree At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations. At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace Role Number: 200681430-0399
title: Product Marketing Manager, Mac & iPad (f/m/d)

description: Hrs As a Company HRS is reinventing the way businesses stay, work and pay in today’s dynamic global marketplace. As a global technology company HRS is focused on leveraging technology and Artificial Intelligence to create fully-digital lodging and meeting experiences for corporations, their travelers and their lodging partners. The company’s platform-based solutions are reinventing end-to-end travel management and the traveler experience for transient, meetings and workforce segments for Fortune 500 companies worldwide. Beyond cost savings HRS clients gain from an unrivaled focus on essential aspects including traveler satisfaction, risk mitigation and savings. HRS is also recognized for its award-winning Green Stay Initiative, technology that helps corporate hotel programs achieve their NetZero targets. HRS works with world’s leading hotel chains, regional hospitality groups and payment providers. CHALLENGES As Product Marketing Manager – Payment, your mission is to position our payment solutions as the essential final step in the end-to-end journey of corporate lodging and meetings. You’ll define and execute the go-to-market strategy for payments, ensuring decision-makers across our ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) segments recognize the value of our payment processes. You Will Lead the product marketing strategy for payments & partnerships, shaping how we position our end-to-end settlement solutions for lodging and meetings across markets. Translate complex payment processes and innovations into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with both decision-makers and users. Bridge commercial goals and technical systems with a unified marketing vision that highlights payments as the critical final step in the end-to-end journey, driving measurable business impact. This is a pivotal role in establishing a scalable, data-informed, and cohesive GTM foundation for the payment segment — in close collaboration with Product, Sales, and Corporate Marketing teams. Responsibilities Strategy: Define and lead the go-to-market for Payments across lodging and meetings, positioning payments as the final step in the booking-to-reimburse journey across our platforms, tailored to our segmentation. Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated messaging that communicates the value of secure, automated, policy-compliant payments — including fraud controls, invoice accuracy, reconciliation, data visibility and vat reclaim — reflecting the technical innovation behind HRS Copilot. Enablement: Equip Sales, Customer Success, and Partners with materials, training, demos, and positioning to win multi-stakeholder deals (Travel, Procurement, Finance/AP) and clearly show the booking → payment → reimburse flow. Campaigns: Plan and execute cross-channel lifecycle and demand generation campaigns that drive payment attach and usage across geographies, in collaboration with corporate marketing. Content: Build and manage impactful assets — thought leadership, digital content, case studies, use cases, product guides, webinars — tailored to decision-makers in lodging and meetings. Cross-functional Collaboration: Align with Product, Sales, Risk/Compliance, Finance Ops, Data, and Integrations to ensure launches and GTM are scalable, consistent, and effective across platforms. Competitive Intelligence: Provide insights on market trends, regulations, buyer needs, and competitor moves in corporate payments to sharpen positioning and inform the innovation roadmap. Reporting: Track attach rate, adoption, payment success/authorization rates, invoice match rate, time-to-reconcile, and revenue contribution; gather feedback and continuously optimize. FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH... Product Marketing Experience 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B product marketing within a fintech SaaS environment , with a strong focus on payments. Experience in marketplace or enterprise travel solutions is a plus. Demonstrated ability to build go-to-market strategies, develop differentiated messaging, and drive adoption for complex, multi-stakeholder products. Go-to-Market Strategy Proven ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies that drive adoption and revenue across international markets. Positioning And Value Proposition Expertise in crafting clear, differentiated value propositions that resonate with B2B decision-makers and reflect product innovation. Campaign And Content Execution Hands-on experience planning and delivering marketing campaigns, including messaging, content creation, and enablement materials. Sales And Marketing Collaboration Demonstrated ability to align sales and marketing activities, ensuring consistent messaging and seamless execution across functions. Market And Customer Understanding Proficiency in conducting market research, analyzing buyer needs, and adapting strategies to match customer expectations. Messaging And Communication Skills Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey product value across a variety of channels and audiences. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to work effectively with product, sales, and marketing teams to ensure launch readiness and ongoing alignment. Analytical And Data-Driven Decision Making Comfort using performance data and insights to optimize marketing efforts and support strategic planning. AI And Digital Transformation Exposure Experience with AI-driven platforms or contributing to marketing strategies in digitally transforming industries is a strong plus. Adaptability In a Fast-Paced Environment Comfort with ambiguity and change, with the ability to integrate evolving products into customer-facing narratives quickly. Language Skills Fluency in English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus. PERSPECTIVE Access to a global network of a globally united and mutually responsible “Tribe of Intrapreneurs” that is passionately dedicated to disrupting the travel industry and while doing so reinventing the ways how businesses stay, work and pay. Our entrepreneurial-driven environment of full ownership and execution focus offers you the playground to contribute to a greater mission, while growing personally and professionally throughout this unique journey. You will continuously learn from a radical culture of retrospectives and continuous improvement and actively contribute to making business life better, smarter and more sustainable. LOCATION The position is based in Berlin, Germany. The attractive remuneration is in line with the market and, in addition to a fixed monthly salary, all necessary work equipment, will also include an annual or multi-year bonus. Compensation Range: €75K - €85K
